faqs.answer: We're based in Visakhapatnam, but our engineering teams design, install and maintain systems for clients across Andhra Pradesh — including plants, hospitals and retail groups outside the city.
faqs.question: Do you only work in Visakhapatnam, or across Andhra Pradesh?

faqs.answer: Share your requirement through the quote form on this page or visit our showroom — our engineers typically respond with a sized solution and quote within 24 hours.
faqs.question: How fast can I get a quote?

faqs.answer: Both, always. Every product we stock is designed, supplied, installed and maintained by our own trained engineers — never subcontracted — with a dedicated service manager for ongoing support.
faqs.question: Do you only sell products, or also install and maintain them?

faqs.answer: Only world-class, pioneer brands in each category — Schneider Electric, Blue Star, Polycab, RR Kabel, Crompton, Cummins, Honeywell and more — so spares and service are never a problem.
faqs.question: What brands do you deal in?

faqs.answer: Yes — walk into our Visakhapatnam showroom to compare products on the shelf before you decide, or have our engineers visit your site directly for a free assessment.
faqs.question: Can I see products in person before buying?

faqs.answer: 24×7 support with a dedicated service manager for every discipline we install in — from AMC contracts to emergency call-outs.
